payload.friendly_name: One authority for committed orientation content
payload.purpose_context: Committed agent orientation blocks can name the checkout directory instead of the recorded project, and neither upgrade nor doctor repair them, so agents see a different project than the session-start hook reports (#5215). One owner decides the committed block content and when it is stale.
payload.purpose_tldr: Upgrade, doctor --fix and the session-start hook show the same project name in agent orientation files.
